calculation.description: Cross-sectionally ranks the prior completed session's negative return, scaled by trailing 20-session daily return volatility.
calculation.signal_lag: Uses data through the previous completed trading day; forward return starts at the next session.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive, but ICIR 0.05919 is below the benchmark admission threshold 0.0840; the factor therefore fails re-validation despite positive recent performance.

provenance.signal_artifact: Reproducible close-price expression; no future data used.
